description: Step 6 of Open Commerce Pathways: the real money in and out of the wallet that paid for your x402 compute runs, from Base USDC transfers we scan onchain since its first run. Income counts only x402 (EIP-3009) payments to that wallet; plain transfers in are deposits. Spend is split into our fees, route sellers and other; spend.planned_usdc and income.planned_usdc are the planned line (purchases a Pathways plan issued, and x402 sales after the first of them). profit is true only when coverage is current and net_planned_usdc is positive; net_usdc is the whole wallet. Free within the per-IP allowance, then $0.002. Live data only.

wallet.description: The address that paid for a pathway session or compute run.
